plain.li: Halfway there, and the hard part is still ahead of us.
We're halfway on "{AMBITION}" with days still in hand.
[winter] Halfway through "{AMBITION}", with frost on the tools every morning.
[afterraid] Even with the raid, we're halfway there.

warm.li: Halfway already, and that's down to every one of you.

blunt.li: Halfway, and I know exactly who's been slacking.

cheerful.li: Halfway! I've been scratching off the days on the wall by my bed.

gloomy.li: Halfway. There's still plenty of time for it to fall apart.

cold.li: Half done, and at this pace we finish with days to spare.

plain.li: Only a few days left for "{AMBITION}", and a lot of it still to do.
I promised the council we'd finish this, so please don't make a liar of me.
[night] Can't sleep for counting what's left of "{AMBITION}".

warm.li: I know you're tired, but a few more days and we'll have done this together.

blunt.li: There's hardly any time left, and we're nowhere near done.

cheerful.li: We can still do it if we all skip lunch tomorrow!

gloomy.li: We won't make it, and it was my idea in the first place.

cold.li: At this rate "{AMBITION}" fails unless more hands go to it.
